nodes.title: 02 / Scene prompt + notes
widgets_values:
Describe this photo for a photographer who will restage it with a different model. Her face, hair, skin, makeup and body are already specified elsewhere, so never mention them. Write exactly six sentences, each under 25 words, in this order and nothing else:
1. Shot type and framing: selfie, mirror selfie, or photographed by someone else; which body parts are in frame; camera height, angle and distance.
2. Pose: torso and head direction, each arm, each hand and what it holds; say where the phone is, or that no phone is visible; legs and feet if in frame.
3. Gaze direction and mouth shape.
4. Clothing top to bottom: color, cut, fabric, prints or text, hats, sunglasses, hair clips, necklaces, bracelets, tattoos, and what is bare.
5. Setting and background objects from left to right.
6. Light direction, hardness and color.
State only what is visible; never guess hidden things. Refer to her as 'she'. No numbering, no labels, no preamble.
Requested changes to apply silently, as if they were already true in the photo (write 'none' means no changes):
